description.value: Moxie's West Georgia is a newly renovated premium casual bar and grill in downtown Vancouver, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, lush greenery, and an exclusive rooftop patio near BC Place and Rogers Arena. Situated at the corner of West Georgia and Cambie Street, it is steps from the Stadium-Chinatown SkyTrain Station and the Vancouver Financial District. An OpenTable Diners' Choice 2024 winner, it serves brunch, happy hour menus, and full dinner, and can host private events in dedicated event spaces.
